headline: Monday at the lake: sunny and pleasant with highs near 82°F
lede: Monday, October 5 brings classic early-fall Branson weather — sunny skies, highs in the lower 80s, and virtually no chance of rain. A perfect day to get out on Table Rock Lake, enjoy a matinee show, or explore the Landing and Strip with the family.

featured.title: Table Rock Lake Day
featured.why: Sunny skies, mild temperatures, and light winds make this an ideal day for boating, fishing, or hiking the state park trails. Pair it with a show or dinner on the water.

plan.title: Morning lakeside start
plan.detail: Enjoy sunrise over Table Rock or a quiet breakfast at Steamy Joe Cafe before the day begins.

plan.title: Lake or show time
plan.detail: Head to the water for boating or State Park trails. Afternoon shows offer family entertainment with easy parking.

plan.title: Evening on the Landing
plan.detail: Stroll Branson Landing for lights, dining, and fountain shows. Relaxed pace with pleasant temperatures.
